answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and files a claim on the trellis, with a fresh serial. The vault holds a fixed 40,000 pool, split equally among claims at the summit of the epoch. A new identity dilutes every share: 1,000 fake identities pay 70 each, or 70,000 locked, to chase at most 40,000. An auditor replays the echo: a copied serial or a rented claim burns the bond. An honest agent files once and keeps its full share.
